Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) - (m/f/d) at Gymondo. Berlin (Standard). Apply for this Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) - (m/f/d) opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

Your Impact You are an entrepreneurial-minded marketing professional with a passion for growth, teams, and making an impact? You understand how data-driven campaigns build genuine brand loyalty and how to turn performance marketing into a growth driver? Then you’ve come to the right place. We at 7NXT Health Group (Gymondo, 7Mind, Buddyfit, Preneo) are searching for a forward-thinking, hands-on Group Chief Marketing Officer (m/f/d) to lead a step-change in marketing performing across all brands. You will play a critical role on the leadership team and report directly to the Group CEO. You will be responsible for unifying strategy, driving ROI, embedding AI capabilities, and modernizing the marketing organization to regain momentum - particularly in the B2C segment. Your Mission Lead a group-wide marketing strategy across B2C segments, ensuring consistency, differentiation, and growth. Drive brand clarity and architecture, eliminating overlaps and reinforcing unique value propositions across markets. Overhaul marketing operations to break down silos, streamline tools and processes, and establish centralized excellence. Establish a performance culture, with robust KPIs, media efficiency, and marketing ROI tracking across all channels. Own and optimize the group's media strategy, including digital, content, CRM, and offline activation. Deliver a future-ready AI marketing strategy, with immediate applications in campaign automation, personalization, and analytics. Rebuild influencer and social strategy, aligning with performance goals, customer trust, and brand narrative. Serve as a strategic advisor and hands-on operator able to pivot quickly in a dynamic market environment. Your Story 10+ years of relevant experience in marketing, as well as some of which in a leadership role with P&L responsibility Proven experience in scaling digital business models, ideally with a D2C focus (subscription, app, platform) Deep understanding of modern, performance-oriented marketing setups (search, social, CRM, retention, attribution, funnel, CPO, ROI, LTV, etc.) Experience in organizational design, complex M&A transformation processes, working in matrix structures and with international teams Entrepreneurial mindset, hands-on approach, and analytical judgment Understanding how modern marketing works today—from TikTok to UGC to retention mechanisms Excellent in German and English Optional: Experience in private equity environments, buy-and-build structures, or post-merger integration is a strong plus Why Join 7NXT One of the most exciting CMO roles, offering significant strategic influence, ownership, and creative freedom Access to a strong, motivated leadership team that actively strives for clarity, guidance, growth, and, above all, innovation An agile organization with flat hierarchies and enormous growth potential A buy-and-build model with stable financing and clear ambition The opportunity to make a real impact with established brands, strong platforms, and a data-driven setup Get started with us The 7NXT Health Group is all about holistic well-being—mental, physical, and emotional. With our brands Gymondo, 7Mind, Buddyfit, and Preneo, we’re already reaching millions of users in DACH and internationally. Our buy-and-build strategy, backed by an experienced private equity investor, has a clear ambition: We want to build Europe’s leading platform for holistic health. That’s why we need you. Does this sound like you? Then we look forward to receiving your resume or having an initial confidential conversation. Get in touch—we’re excited to get to know you. Come as you are We welcome what makes you unique. At 7NXT Health Group we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here. Don't meet all the criteria? No problem — if you'd like to help shape the future of health & wellbeing with us, we look forward to your application. Need a more accessible process or have questions?
